mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% (measured as a 3-month increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings slowdowns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales (measured as 3-month changes) signal robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of interaction periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100 for 3 consecutive months), supply chain disruptions reduce manufacturing output and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate revenues, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in payroll employment (measured as 3-month changes) signal a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of expanding industrial production (INDPRO > 100 for 3 consecutive months), supply chain improvements boost manufacturing output and corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
